text: Locking a user's reputation tokens instead of fungible assets would be a leap in efficiency and a powerful economic advantage over traditional finance, but this advantage is conditional on a coherent system that securely tracks the value of a reputation token.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Reputation as Capital – How DAOs Upgrade Finance (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3949098

isBasedOn.name: Reputation as Capital – How DAOs Upgrade Finance
